title: Richie Rich
tagline: The richest kid in the world wants a mate and a burger.
about: The world's richest boy has everything except friends, until villains try to steal the family fortune.
cue: Serve the mains when Richie takes his new friends to his own burger bar at the mansion.
faces: "Personally, I'd settle for soda and hot dogs at Wrigley Field."

    StartersGold coin crackersThyme parmesan crisps stacked like coins, with fig jam and brieHow to make it150g parmesan, finely grated1 tsp chopped thyme4 tbsp fig jam200g brieMix the parmesan with the thyme. Spoon small rounds onto a lined tray and flatten into coins.Bake at 190°C until golden and lacy, then cool on the tray.Serve stacked like coins with fig jam and a wedge of brie.Mansion caviar blinisWarm blinis with crème fraîche, salmon roe, chives and a squeeze of lemonHow to make it16 blinis200ml crème fraîche50g salmon roe1 tbsp snipped chives1 lemonWarm the blinis in a low oven for 5 minutes.Top each with a small spoon of crème fraîche, a little salmon roe and a few chives.Add a tiny squeeze of lemon and lay them out in neat rows.Professor Keenbean's popcorn chickenThe inventor's workshop under the mansionHow to make itAs written, serves 4Bite-sized chicken thigh soaked in buttermilk, fried in a crunchy cornflake crust, tossed in a parmesan and garlic dust with a honey sriracha dip.Cut 600g chicken thighs into 2cm pieces and soak in 250ml buttermilk with salt for 1 hour.Crush 100g cornflakes and mix with 50g plain flour and 1 tsp garlic powder.Toss the chicken in the crumbs and fry at 175°C for 4 minutes until golden.Toss hot with 30g finely grated parmesan and a pinch of salt.Mix 3 tbsp honey with 1 tsp sriracha and 2 tbsp mayonnaise to dip.Lobster sliders with lemon mayoMount Richmore, with Richie's face.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsRichie's home burger barSmashed cheeseburgers with pickle special sauce on toasted bunsHow to make it600g beef mince8 slices of American cheese4 burger buns1 brown onion, sliced8 dill pickle slices4 tbsp chopped pickles, for the sauce4 tbsp mayonnaise1kg potatoes, cut into fries2 tbsp oilToss the potatoes, cut into fries, in oil and bake at 220°C, turning once, until golden.Mix the mayonnaise with the chopped pickles for the special sauce. Roll the mince into 4 balls.Smash the balls flat on a very hot pan. Season, flip after 2 minutes and add the cheese.Build on toasted buns with onion, pickles and sauce. Serve with the fries.Rich family mini beef WellingtonsDinner in the huge dining roomHow to make itAs written, serves 4Seared beef fillet wrapped in mushroom duxelles, prosciutto and golden puff pastry, with a glossy beef and thyme jus and buttery mash.Sear 4 x 150g beef fillet steaks hard for 1 minute a side and cool.Fry 300g finely chopped mushrooms with garlic and thyme until dry.Lay 2 slices prosciutto on each, spread with mushroom, add a steak and wrap.Wrap each in a square of puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 220°C for 18 minutes.Reduce 400ml beef stock with thyme to a jus.Serve with mash.SweetsGold vault sundaeVanilla ice cream, salted caramel sauce, crushed honeycomb and a gold chocolate coinHow to make it1 L vanilla ice cream150g caster sugar150ml thickened creamsalt, a small pinch100g honeycomb, crushed4 gold chocolate coinsMelt the sugar in a dry pan to amber, then whisk in the cream and salt.
